description: Pro clip library for side-by-side comparison. Each clip is a 4-5s window around a stroke. Per-player metadata (qid, handedness, gender, birth_year) sourced from Wikidata via scripts/fetch_pros_from_wikidata.py; backhand_style is filled manually where Wikidata is silent — the raw fetch is preserved at pros/wikidata_cache.json so a refresh can't clobber human curation.

schema_changelog.v3: 2026-05-09 — added qid/handedness/gender/birth_year/backhand_style per player; expanded roster from 4 to 24. Replaces hardcoded PRO_HANDEDNESS dict in scripts/pro_comparison.py.
schema_changelog.v2: Earlier — 4-player roster (Alcaraz/Djokovic/Federer/Nadal), no per-player metadata, handedness hardcoded in code.
